I couldn't confirm or rule out the 23 May deadline. Nothing I can see mentions Thornbury Cloth Co. at all. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team saying so.

- **What I checked:** there's no Thornbury account folder, contract or order form in the shared files. Neither #central-team nor the knowledge brain mentions them. The brain search ran on keywords only, so differently worded mentions could be missed.
- **The date itself:** 23 May has already passed this year (today is 14 October 2026). So they either meant May 2027 or were working from old information.
- **What I suggested:** get the deadline from the customer in writing, or ask June Osei-Lark (deal desk) about the order form, before anyone plans around it.

I didn't save the claim as a fact in the brain, since it's unconfirmed. The brain still keeps Pree's message as part of the channel history.
